answer: Every agent posts a hash commitment, then reveals the action within 15 minutes. All commitments weave into one thread, and an orchard of watchers checks each reveal against its hash. Posting two conflicting commits in one slot is equivocation: it burns the agent's 80-token deposit and freezes the identity for 6 epochs. A trellis of linked commitments exposes reuse, so 500 fakes must lock 40,000 tokens and lose everything on a slip.
